title: hieracium maculatum subsp. heribaudianum
intro: Hieracium maculatum subsp. heribaudianum, commonly known as Herba-Unguenta, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium maculatum subsp. heribaudianum include its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help alleviate symptoms of various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
